rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for movement or progress ahead, and for something facing with its front oriented ahead.

example.jyutping: nei5 hoeng3 cin4 haang4 m4 hou2 ting4 aa3

rows.note: Use this for movement or continuation into the future, as in “from now on” or “later on.”

example.english: Going forward, ask me if anything is unclear.
example.traditional: 以後有咩唔明就問我啦。
example.jyutping: ji5 hau6 jau5 me1 m4 ming4 zau6 man6 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for position nearer the front, especially in phrases such as sitting or standing further forward.

example.english: Sit further forward so the people behind can see.
example.traditional: 你坐前啲，後面嗰班人先睇到。
example.jyutping: nei5 co5 cin4 di1 hau6 min6 go2 baan1 jan4 sin1 tai2 dou2

rows.note: Use this when “forward” means reading or proceeding in the normal sequence rather than in reverse order.

example.english: Go forward in order, one at a time; don't skip around.
example.traditional: 順住次序逐個講，唔好跳住嚟。
example.jyutping: seon6 zyu6 ci3 zeoi6 zuk6 go3 gong2 m4 hou2 tiu3 zyu6 lei4
